class.name: OpenWorldTerrain3D
class.description: [OpenWorldTerrain3D] renders a regular patch mesh and displaces it in the vertex shader using height data from [OpenWorldTerrainData]. This module is intentionally separate from [SimpleTerrain3D] so large-world rendering experiments can continue without changing the CPU chunk terrain workflow.

method.name: apply_brush
method.description: Applies a brush edit to the CPU height data and refreshes the generated height texture.

method.name: apply_brush_with_delta
method.description: Applies a brush edit and returns changed [code]indices[/code], [code]before[/code], and [code]after[/code] arrays for undo/redo.

method.name: apply_height_patch
method.description: Applies normalized height values to the given height data indices.

method.name: generate_random_terrain
method.description: Fills [member terrain_data] with deterministic value-noise heights and refreshes rendering.

method.name: get_brush_hit
method.description: Intersects a world-space ray against the CPU height field and returns hit information for editor tools.

method.name: get_debug_lines
method.description: Returns local-space debug lines used by the editor gizmo.

method.name: get_height_texture
method.description: Returns the generated height texture used by the built-in displacement material.

method.name: rebuild
method.description: Rebuilds the patch mesh, refreshes the height texture, and reapplies the active material.

method.name: reset_flat_terrain
method.description: Fills the terrain with a flat normalized height and refreshes rendering.
